public_rationale: Google had publicly reported nearly 800% year-over-year revenue growth from products built on its own AI models. That is a real sign of rapid AI revenue growth beyond the excluded infrastructure purchases. It contradicts the ordinary absence-of-signs reading. It does not answer the different question of whether the resulting dollars justify hyperscaler investment.
limitations: The conclusion depends on reading explosion as very rapid revenue growth, rather than an unstated dollar threshold tied to capital spending.
The evidence is a company disclosure without an absolute revenue figure or customer-level reconciliation.
